text: No tree-cover loss of 0.5 hectares or more was detected on this 130.9-hectare rural property between 2021 and 2025. The latest satellite data (2025) and forest reference maps (2020) show no significant deforestation events. However, smaller changes (under 0.5 ha) or those at property edges might not be visible due to the 30-meter resolution of the imagery. The property had minimal tree cover in 2000 (0.4 ha) and was classified as non-forest in 2020. While no large-scale cutting is confirmed, smaller-scale activities cannot be ruled out.
